title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves adjusting the values of a variable so that its mean becomes zero. This is done by subtracting the mean of the variable from each data point. How might this affect the coefficients in a linear regression model?

title: Exploring Full Column Rank
text: When a matrix has full column rank, it means that all its columns are linearly independent. How does this property affect the solution to a linear regression problem?

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Intercept
